from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]
    blank = next(c for c in range(1, w) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))
    panel_w = blank

    objects = {}
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row[blank + 1:] if v != 0}
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(blank + 1, w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        profile = tuple(sum(grid[r][c] == color for c in range(blank + 1, w)) for r in range(lo, hi + 1))
        objects[profile] = color

    out = [row[:panel_w] for row in grid]
    divider = [all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(panel_w)) for r in range(h)]
    cuts = [-1] + [r for r, yes in enumerate(divider) if yes] + [h]
    for a, b in zip(cuts, cuts[1:]):
        rows = list(range(a + 1, b))
        if not rows:
            continue
        profile = tuple(sum(grid[r][c] == 0 for c in range(1, panel_w - 1)) for r in rows)
        color = objects[profile]
        for r in rows:
            for c in range(1, panel_w - 1):
                if grid[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-6068c98a.py'
